patterns.note: The site uses distinct, full-width color-blocked sections to segment content, creating a strong visual rhythm down the page.
Display headings are set in a very large, bold, and often uppercase sans-serif font, creating a high-impact, almost poster-like effect, contrasting with more understated body text.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is punctuated by vibrant, saturated accent colors (red, light blue, green, yellow) used for full-bleed section backgrounds and key interactive elements.

The homepage features a full-bleed video hero that plays automatically. The primary navigation is sticky at the top. While a scroll sequence for the homepage was not provided, it is typical for sticky navigation to transform (e.g., change background color) as it scrolls past the hero, and for content sections to reveal with entrance animations as they enter the viewport.
Event listings are presented in a grid of cards, each featuring an image, title, and date, with a prominent call to action button.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a looping background video with text overlaid for immediate visual impact. The primary navigation is implemented as a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the screen; it is expected to transition its background from transparent to solid black as the user scrolls past the hero section. Section content below the hero is likely to reveal with subtle entrance animations (e.g., fade-up or slide-in) as it enters the viewport, leveraging CSS keyframes. Interactive elements like event listings likely use a carousel library such as Swiper for navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~3-5x body text) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant for most elements and sections, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with airy, full-bleed hero and feature sections, transitioning to a more compact grid for event listings.

standout: The site's distinctive use of bold, high-contrast color blocking for full-width sections, combined with raw, almost industrial typography for display headings, creates a powerful and memorable visual identity that feels both modern and artistic. If a builder copied only one idea from this site, it should be the dramatic, full-bleed color-blocked sections with stark, oversized typography.
